TFT13_TeamupAugment_Sisters.name: Trait: Sisters

ability.desc: Summon a flying saucer over the current target that lasts @AugmentedDuration@@Duration@ seconds. Each second it deals @ModifiedDamagePerSecond@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to the target, plus @ModifiedSplitDamagePerSecond@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage split between all enemies within @SecondaryHexRange@ hex. The saucer deals @TankDamageIncrease*100@% increased damage to Tanks.If an enemy under the UFO dies, Bard has a @AbductChance*100@% chance to abduct them and create a 1-star copy on your bench.Meep bonus: On combat start, grant the nearest @ModifiedNumAllies@ (%i:set14AmpIcon%) Meeple allies an additional Meep.Friends abducted: @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT17_Bard_FriendsAbducted@

ability.name: Explosive Attitude
ability.desc: Fire a barrage of @ModifiedNumRockets@ (%i:scaleAS%) rockets in a cone, each dealing @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to the first target hit.

ability.name: Test of Spirit
ability.desc: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @Duration@ seconds. Over the duration, drain @ModifiedHealthDrain@ (%i:scaleAP%) Health from the nearest @NumEnemies@ enemies. Then slam down, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to all enemies within 2 hexes.

ability.name: Hopped-Up Hacks
ability.desc: Open a @SpellHexRadius@ hex rift containing the target, Hacking enemies within for @HexDuration@ seconds and dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to each, plus @ModifiedSplitDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage split between all enemies hit.Hacked enemies store @HexPercent*100@% of all damage they take. When the Hack ends, they take true damage equal to the stored damage. The Hack ends early if it would kill the target.

ability.name: Perfect Bladework
ability.desc: Passive: Every @NumAttacks@ attacks, reveal a Vital on the target. If a Vital exists, dash to attack it dealing @ModifiedVitalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) bonus true damage and heal for @PercentHealing*100@% of the damage dealt.Active: Reveal @NumVitals@ Vitals on the target and quickly attack them all. If the target dies, remaining Vitals transfer to the nearest enemy. Upon striking the final Vital, create a two hex aura that heals allies within for @ModifiedHealing@ (%i:scaleAP%) over @AuraDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Slingshot Maneuver
ability.desc: Passive: Every 5th attack, launch a returning boomerang at the target that travels two hexes past the first enemy it hits. It deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerHit*100@% per hit.Meep Bonus: @ModifiedNumMeeps@ (%i:set14AmpIcon%) Meeps attack alongside Gnar, dealing @ModifiedMeepDPS@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAS%) physical damage per second.

ability.name: Meep Bait
ability.desc: Dash through the current target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. Every third cast also summons a Mega Meep after a delay, briefly knocking the target up and dealing @ModifiedChompDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%%i:set14AmpIcon%) magic damage. Adjacent enemies take @SecondaryDamage*100@% damage.Meep Bonus: Add @ModifiedNumMeeps@ (%i:set14AmpIcon%) Meep to the bait, increasing Mega Meep damage by @ModifiedMeepBonusDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%).

ability.name: Gravitational Spin
ability.desc: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then, strike enemies in a three hex line, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%%i:scaleArmor%) magic damage.Meep Bonus: Reduce the damage of incoming attacks by @ModifiedFlatDR@ (%i:set14AmpIcon%). After being attacked @AttacksPerPassiveTrigger@ times, deal @ModifiedPassiveDamage@ (%i:scaleArmor%%i:set14AmpIcon%) magic damage in a two hex radius.

ability.name: Huddle Up!
ability.desc: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. For the duration, allies within two hexes gain @ModifiedResists@ (%i:scaleAP%) Armor and Magic Resistance.Meep Bonus: Meeps grant @ModifiedMeepShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield to the nearest @ModifiedNumMeeps@ (%i:set14AmpIcon%) allies for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Asteroid Blaster
ability.desc: Strafe to a nearby position, unleashing @BaseMissiles@ missiles split between the target and all enemies within two hexes. Missiles deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage with a @ProcChance@% Lucky chance of firing a mega missile that deals @ModifiedProcDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) instead.Meep Bonus: Every @ModifiedMeepCooldown@ (%i:set14AmpIcon%) seconds, launch an Explosive Meep at the target, dealing @ModifiedMeepDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage in a one hex radius on impact.Lucky: Check twice and take the better outcome.

ability.name: Meepteor Shower
ability.desc: Call down a Meepteor on the target that deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.Meep Bonus: An additional @ModifiedMiniMeeps@ (%i:set14AmpIcon%) mini Meepteor are called down on nearby targets dealing @ModifiedMiniDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage each.

ability.name: Stellar Slash
ability.desc: Heal @ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%), then deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleArmor%) physical damage to the current target.N.O.V.A. Strike: Cleave the battlefield, briefly knocking up all enemies and dealing @ModifiedNovaDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleArmor%) physical damage.

ability.name: Aim For The Head
ability.desc: Passive: Attacks have a @ProcChance@% Lucky chance to fire an empowered Headshot, dealing @ModifiedHeadshotDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage.N.O.V.A. Strike: Mark all enemies, increasing damage taken by @NovaMarkDamageAmp*100@%. The first time marked targets drop below @NovaMarkThreshold*100@% Health, Headshot them for @ModifiedNovaHeadshotDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage.Lucky: Check twice and take the better outcome.

ability.name: Grasp of Convergence
ability.desc: Passive: Gain @PassiveRatio*100@% more max Health from all sources.Active: Converge an X-shape of vines on the target, dealing @DamageTotal@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to each enemy hit and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds. N.O.V.A. Strike: Send forth a wave of dragons that stun all enemies for @NovaStunDuration@ seconds. For the rest of combat, Maokai's attacks deal @ModifiedNovaDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%) bonus physical damage.

ability.name: Cosmic Pursuit
ability.desc: Passive: Attacks and Abilities mark the target. When an enemy reaches @MaxMarks@ marks, Wolf consumes the marks, dealing @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage. Active: Jump up to @HexDistance@ hex away and fire arrows at the nearest @NumTargets@ targets, each dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage. N.O.V.A. Strike: Gain @NovaDamageAmp*100@% Damage Amp. Now and every @NovaRepeatTimer@ seconds after, add a mark to all enemies.

ability.name: Bullet Cluster
ability.desc: Passive: On takedown, gain @ManaPerKill@ mana.Active: Fire @BaseNumMissiles@ missiles in a @HexRange@-hex radius around the current target, dealing @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage each.

ability.name: Singularity
ability.desc: Gather the force of a black hole, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage split between the target and the @NumEnemies@ closest enemies to them. The target takes an additional @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.

ability.name: Space Opera
ability.desc: Passive: Jhin has a fixed attack speed of @FixedAS@ and converts every @PercentBonusASToConvert*100@% of bonus Attack Speed into @ADConversionRate@ bonus Attack Damage.Active: Summon @NumHands@ spectral hands that fire alongside Jhin for the next @NumAttacks@ attacks. Each hand deals @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage per shot. The final shots deal @FinalShotPercentDamageIncrease*100@% more damage and pierce through the most enemies in a line, dealing @PercentDamageReductionPerTargetHit*100@% reduced damage per target hit.

ability.name: Unstoppable Dreadnought
ability.desc: Passive - Proximity Blast: Whenever an enemy enters a @ShotgunRange@ (%i:scaleRange%) hex radius, fire a blast in a cone towards the closest adjacent hex that deals @ModifiedShotgunDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage with @FalloffPerHex*100@% falloff per hex. Each adjacent hex has a @ShotgunCooldown@ second cooldown, and starts combat on cooldown.Active: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and reposition up to one hex to maximize the number of targets within Proximity Blast's radius. Reset Proximity Blast's cooldowns.

ability.name: Deathbeam
ability.desc: Channel a deathbeam in a line towards the current target for @AugmentedDuration@@Duration@ seconds. It deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage per second, reduced by @DamageReductionPerTarget*100@% per enemy it passes through. Deathbeam ignores @MagicPen*100@% of the enemy's Magic Resist.

ability.name: Gravity Matrix
ability.desc: Enter a defensive stance for @DurabilityDuration@ seconds gaining @Durability*100@% Durability. While in the defensive stance, attract nearby enemy projectiles and heal @ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%) over the duration. When this ends, release a shockwave that deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%) as physical damage in a @HexRange@-hex range.

ability.name: Psionic Storm
ability.desc: Channel a one-hex psionic storm that follows enemies for @AugmentedDuration@@Duration@ seconds. Each second, it grows larger and deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies within, reduced by @FalloffPerHex*100@% per hex from the epicenter.

ability.name: Marked for Death
ability.desc: Reposition up to one hex to throw a harpoon at the furthest enemy. The harpoon pulls the first enemy hit one hex forward and deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) physical damage. Then, teleport behind them and cleave, dealing @ModifiedTargetDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to them and @ModifiedAreaDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to nearby enemies.

ability.name: Psi Strikes
ability.desc: Passive: Every third attack is a doubleslash that deals @ModifiedPassiveDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) bonus physical damage.Active: After brief meditation, enter a Psi-State for @Duration@ seconds, gaining @Omnivamp*100@% Omnivamp, @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed, and increased movement speed. Twice a second, fire a psychic projection at a random nearby enemy that deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage

ability.name: Chemical Rage
ability.desc: Heal @ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) over @Duration@ seconds. Then, deal @DamageTotal@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to target and enemies adjacent to them and @ASSlow*100@% Chill them for @CCDuration@ seconds.{{TFT_Keyword_Chill}}

ability.name: Double Time
ability.desc: Passive: Attacks deal @ModifiedHitDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) bonus magic damage and an additional @ModifiedMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) stacking magic damage over @PoisonDuration@ seconds. While an enemy has @GrooveStacks@ or more stacks, Teemo is in {{TFT17_SpaceGroove_TheGroove}}.Active: Gain @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed for @ActiveAttacks@ attacks.

ability.name: Groovin' Susan
ability.desc: Transform for @Duration@ seconds, temporarily gaining @MaxHealth@ max Health, entering {{TFT17_SpaceGroove_TheGroove}}, and dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to adjacent enemies each second.

ability.name: Dance n' Dice
ability.desc: Passive: Attacks deal magic damage. Gwen is in {{TFT17_SpaceGroove_TheGroove}} while targeting an enemy below @GrooveThreshold*100@% Health.Active: Dash to a nearby hex to snip the lowest percent Health enemy, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to the target and @ModifiedAreaDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies in a cone. If this kills, dash and snip again at @ResetDamage*100@% damage!

ability.name: Jump and Jive
ability.desc: Passive: Whenever an enemy is knocked up, shoot them, dealing @ModifiedPassiveDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage and entering {{TFT17_SpaceGroove_TheGroove}} for @GrooveDuration@ seconds.Active: Unleash a volley of bullets at the target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage and knocking up for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Disco Inferno
ability.desc: Passive: On combat start, forge a temporary completed item. If 3 items are already equipped, a random completed item becomes Radiant this combat instead.Active: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds, then breath fire in a cone dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. After any Shield on Ornn expires, Ornn enters {{TFT17_SpaceGroove_TheGroove}} for @GrooveDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Bubble Pop
ability.desc: Toss a disco bubble at the target that deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) split between enemies in a one hex radius. The explosion sends @NumProjectiles@ globs towards nearby enemies that deal @ModifiedFirstBounceDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. On cast, Nami enters {{TFT17_SpaceGroove_TheGroove}} for @GrooveDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Party Crasher
ability.desc: Passive: Every @BoltCooldown@ seconds, call down a bolt on the highest Health nearby enemy that deals @ModifiedBoltDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.Active: Summon a disco ball at the largest clump of enemies, then knock up the current target into it, dealing @ModifiedUppercutDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. They crash down into the disco ball, dealing @ModifiedExplosionDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage in a three hex radius. Enter {{TFT17_SpaceGroove_TheGroove}} for @GrooveDurationPerTarget@ second per enemy hit.

ability.name: Psionic Crush
ability.desc: Hurl a chunk of magnetic debris at the nearest target without one, dealing @ModifiedDebrisDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage and sticking it to them. If an enemy with debris dies, it passes to the nearest enemy without one.Every @NumCasts@ casts, instead rip off all debris dealing @ModifiedDebrisRipDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage, then crush all the debris onto the target, dealing @ModifiedSlamDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage and briefly stunning them.

ability.name: Fate's Gambit
ability.desc: Draw a card with a value between 1 and 9 by Lucky chance, then throw it at the target. Based on the card drawn, deal between @ModifiedDamageMin@ (%i:scaleAP%) and @ModifiedDamageMax@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. Overkill damage bounces to the nearest enemy. 3-Star Bonus: If a 9 is thrown, generate 1 gold.Lucky: Check twice and take the better outcome.

ability.name: Diviner's Judgment
ability.desc: Stab the target, causing them to bleed for @ModifiedBleedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage over @BleedDuration@ seconds. After the attack, leap to the highest percent Health enemy within @HexDistance@ hexes.

ability.name: Counter Star-ike
ability.desc: Enter a defensive stance for @Duration@ seconds, reducing incoming damage by @ModifiedFlatDR@ and gaining @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield. When the stance ends, strike all nearby enemies, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%) magic damage and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ second(s).

ability.name: It's Raining Stars
ability.desc: Passive: Gain a different secondary effect each game based on the Stargazer constellation.Active: Call down something from the sky, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to @NumEnemies@ nearby enemies and do some special effect based on this game's Stargazer Constellation.

ability.name: Calamity
ability.desc: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Summon an astrolabe to crash down on a nearby hex, dealing @ModifiedInitialDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies within 2 hexes. Then, push the astrolabe towards the end of the board, dealing @ModifiedFollowupDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. All enemies hit by the astrolabe are knocked up for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Lend Me a Hand, Shadow!
ability.desc: Passive: Every time Vex attacks, Shadow strikes a nearby enemy, dealing @ModifiedShadowHandDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. Whenever an enemy is struck @NumStrikesForPassive@ times by Shadow, Shadow strikes them again.Active: Shadow launches @NumActiveStrikes@ empowered strikes, dealing @ModifiedShadowHandMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage instead.

ability.name: Time Warp
ability.desc: Passive: This Ability adapts to Attack Damage or Ability Power, whichever is higher. Attacks deal @ModifiedPassiveAPDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic@ModifiedPassiveADDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage.Active: Dash to a nearby hex, gaining @Shield@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and slashing adjacent enemies for @ModifiedAPDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic@ModifiedADDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage. Every third cast, leap into the air and launch a wave of energy that deals @ModifiedAPWaveDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic@ModifiedADWaveDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to enemies in a line.

ability.name: Reality Tear
ability.desc: Passive: On cast, attacks gain @ModifiedBonusDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) stacking bonus magic damage. Starting from the third cast, gain true damage instead.Active: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds, then slice open a rift on the largest group of champions dealing the Passive's bonus damage to all enemies within. Enemies have their Attack Speed slowed by @ASSlow*100@% while allies within gain @BonusAS*100@% Attack Speed, both rapidly decaying over @BuffDebuffDuration@ seconds. Shen always gains his rift's full bonus for this duration.

ability.name: Mega Time Kick
ability.desc: Kick a ball at the current target that deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. On impact, the ball has a 100% Lucky chance to bounce to a new target dealing @ModifiedBounceDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. These bounces can trigger additional bounces, but the odds halve with each bounce.Lucky: Check twice and take the better outcome.

ability.name: Temporal Shot
ability.desc: Active: Fire a blast at the current target that deals @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage. Every @TakedownsToDrone@ takedowns, gain a drone that deals @ModifiedDroneDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to the current target on cast. (Total Takedowns: @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT17_Ezreal_Takedowns@)

ability.name: Shield of Daybreak
ability.desc: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Bash the current target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%) magic damage and stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Paddle Star
ability.desc: Fire a paddle star at the current target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to the first target hit and @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) to others it passes through. When the missile reaches its destination, redirect it to a distant enemy, increasing its speed and repeating the damage. This redirect can occur @AugmentedNumRedirects@@NumRedirects@ times.

ability.name: Pale Cascade
ability.desc: Passive: Attacks deal @ModifiedBonusDamageToAttacks@ (%i:scaleAP%) bonus magic damage.Active: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield and summon 3 encircling orbs for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Orbs deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies they pass through, and rotate faster based on Attack Speed.

ability.name: Fracture Reality
ability.desc: Passive: Attacks deal @ModifiedBaseAttackDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage instead.Active: Summon @NumClones@ clones that attack alongside for @NumAttacks@ attacks, dealing @CloneDamageMultiplier*100@% damage. For their final attack, clones fire a bolt that deals @ModifiedBoltDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.

ability.name: Accretion
ability.desc: Deal @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to the lowest Health enemy in range and permanently gain @BonusHealthPerCast@ maximum Health. If this kills them, permanently gain @BonusHealthOnKill@ maximum Health instead.(Current Bonus: +@TFTUnitProperty.:TFT17_ChoGathBonusHealth@ Health)

ability.name: Dark Matter
ability.desc: Hurl a shard towards the current target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to the first target it hits. After hitting its initial target or at its final destination, the dagger explodes dealing @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to nearby targets.

ability.name: Quantum Clone
ability.desc: Create a clone behind the target with @HPPenalty*100@% reduced max Health and @ManaCostIncrease@ increased Mana cost. The clone inherits its creator's items, stats, and current Health, and can cast Quantum Clone.

ability.name: Screech
ability.desc: Passive: Attacks deal @ModifiedAADamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) bonus magic damage.Active: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and grant allies @BonusAP@% Ability Power for the rest of combat.

ability.name: Meep Impact
ability.desc: Heal @ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) Health over @HealDuration@ seconds. Slam the target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage and knocking up for @StunDuration@ seconds. The impact creates meepwaves that deal @PercentEffects*100@% of these effects in the target's row.Meep Bonus: Meeps water Meepsie's flower, increasing all incoming Healing and Shielding by @ModifiedHealingAndShielding@ (%i:set14AmpIcon%).

ability.name: Indestructible
ability.desc: Gain @ModifiedInitialShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield. Each second for the next @AugmentedDuration@@Duration@ seconds, gain @ModifiedShieldPerProc@ (%i:scaleAP%) more Shield and deal @ModifiedDamagePerProc@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to adjacent enemies. When this ability ends, consume the remaining Shield and heal for @HealRefund*100@% of its value.

ability.name: Stellar Ricochet
ability.desc: Passive: Attacks bounce to strike @AttackNumEnemies@ times, dealing @PassivePercentReducedDamage*100@% reduced damage per target hit and leaving a Feather behind the final target.Active: Gain @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed for the next @NumAttacks@ attacks. At the end, recall all Feathers split between the closest @RecallFeatherTargets@ enemies, dealing @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage each. Xayah's current target takes @ModifiedPrimaryTargetBonusDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) additional physical damage per feather.

ability.name: Collateral Damage
ability.desc: Passive: Attacks fire @NumProjectiles@ projectiles in a cone that deal @ModifiedPassiveDamage@ (%i:TFTBaseAD%) physical damage each.Active: Fire an explosive shell that deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to the target, and @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage to adjacent enemies.

ability.name: Tounge Lash
ability.desc: Passive: Once per combat after dropping below @HPThreshold*100@% Health, gain Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds equal to @PercentHealingToShield*100@% of healing received this combat.Active: Heal @ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%), then tongue lash all enemies within two hexes dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth%) magic damage.

ability.name: Divine Scythe
ability.desc: Gain @Durability*100@% Durability for @Duration@ seconds, healing @ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%) over the duration. Afterwards, slash forward in a line, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to enemies hit and knocking them up for @KnockupDuration@ second.

ability.name: Temporal Core
ability.desc: Sell Core to gain @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT17_Timebreaker_NumEXP@ XP

ability.name: Upheaval
ability.desc: Heal @TotalHealing@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%), then briefly knock up adjacent enemies and deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.

ability.name: Advanced Defences
ability.desc: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) Shield and @Durability*100@% Durability for @Duration@ seconds. Over the duration, deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage each second to enemies in a cone.

ability.name: Dark Form
ability.desc: Transform for @HealthGainDuration@ seconds, gaining @ModifiedHealthGain@ (%i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth%) Health and tethering to nearby champions. Over the duration, deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to the closest @NumEnemies@ enemies and restore @ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%) health to the closest @NumAllies@ injured allies.

ability.name: Nothing To See Here!
ability.desc: Cosmic Squids lack the intelligence to do anything but mindlessly attack. They're very squishy, though.

ability.name: Nothing To See Here!
ability.desc: Cosmic Scrappers lack the intelligence to do anything but mindlessly attack. They're doing their best though!

ability.name: Nothing To See Here!
ability.desc: Cosmic Bruisers lack the intelligence to do anything but mindlessly attack. Careful, they pack a punch!

ability.name: Nothing To See Here!
ability.desc: Cosmic Flutterbyes lack the intelligence to do anything but mindlessly attack. A bit annoying, really.

ability.name: Nothing To See Here!
ability.desc: Cosmic Gromps lack the intelligence to do anything but mindlessly attack. They're just protecting their...part of the cosmos?

ability.name: Primordial Breath
ability.desc: Passive: Attacks splash in a cone behind the target. Watch out!

ability.name: Tome of Traits
ability.desc: Drag this Tome to the Shop to open an Armory full of emblems! You will have 30 seconds to choose.

ability.name: Gravitational Collapse
ability.desc: A miniature black hole created by a supernova.Gains max health equal to @TOOLTIPDarkStarPercentHP@% of ally Dark Star Health.

ability.name: Harbinger of The End
ability.desc: Passive: Swords fly out in a grid dealing @TotalGridDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage to enemies they hit. Active: Launch @NumSwords@ swords into the air and gain @Durability*100@% Durability. When they land, they deal @TotalSwordAoEDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage to enemies they hit in a @HexRange@-hex range.

TFT17_VexUniqueTrait.name: Doomer
TFT17_VexUniqueTrait.desc: Combat Start: Mark all enemies with Doom.The first time enemies are damaged each combat, their Doom is consumed, stealing @ADAP1@% Attack Damage and Ability Power from them and granting it to your strongest Vex.

TFT17_ASTrait.name: Challenger
TFT17_ASTrait.desc: Your team gains @TeamwideAS*100@% Attack Speed. Challengers gain bonus Attack Speed. When their target dies, Challengers dash to a new target and increase their Attack Speed bonus by @BurstPercent*100@% for @BurstDuration@ seconds.(@MinUnits@) @AttackSpeedPercent*100@% %i:scaleAS%(@MinUnits@) @AttackSpeedPercent*100@% %i:scaleAS%(@MinUnits@) @AttackSpeedPercent*100@% %i:scaleAS%(@MinUnits@) @AttackSpeedPercent*100@% %i:scaleAS%

TFT17_MissFortuneUndeterminedTrait.name: Choose Trait
TFT17_MissFortuneUndeterminedTrait.desc: When you field Miss Fortune, choose between Conduit Mode, Challenger Mode, and Replicator Mode. Miss Fortune has a unique ability based on her mode and gains the associated trait.

TFT17_Stargazer_Wolf.name: Stargazer
TFT17_Stargazer_Wolf.desc: Stargazers chart a different constellation every game. This game: The Boar.Gain gold after winning player combat. Allies in empowered hexes gain @Wolf_Health_Teamwide*100@% Health, Attack Damage, and Ability Power. Stargazers gain more.(Gold Earned: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT17_Stargazer_Wolf_TotalGold@)(@MinUnits@) @Wolf_Gold@ gold, @Wolf_Health*100@% %i:scaleHealth%, @Wolf_ADAP@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%More hexes reveal at each player level

TFT17_APTrait.name: Replicator
TFT17_APTrait.desc: Replicator abilities occur a second time at reduced effectiveness.(@MinUnits@) @Effectiveness*100@% strength

TFT17_ShieldTank.name: Vanguard
TFT17_ShieldTank.desc: Vanguards gain @DamageReductionPct*100@% Durability while Shielded. en.desc: Conduit Abilities last 25% to 50% longer, depending on the Ability. Gain a Zoe and a Mordekaiser.

ko.name: 집중
ko.desc: 전달자 스킬 지속시간이 스킬에 따라 25~50% 증가합니다. 조이와 모데카이저를 획득합니다.

zh.name: 聚精会神
zh.desc: 【神谕】们的技能持续时长变久25%到50%，基于具体技能。获得1个【佐伊】和1个【莫德凯撒】。

es.name: Concentrado
es.desc: Las habilidades de conducto duran entre un 25% y un 50% más, según la habilidad. Obtienes 1 Zoe y 1 Mordekaiser.

fr.name: Concentration
fr.desc: Les compétences des Canalisateurs durent entre 25% et 50% plus longtemps, selon la compétence. Vous gagnez une Zoé et un Mordekaiser.

TFT17_Augment_DarkStar_WhiteHole.name: Loot Singularity
TFT17_Augment_DarkStar_WhiteHole.desc: When the Black Hole consumes enemies, it turns them into space matter. After acquiring enough, the Black Hole turns it into loot! Gain a Cho'gath and a Lissandra. Space matter and loot quality increase each time. Gain 2/3/4 space matter depending on Dark Star breakpoint. Space Matter: /

de.name: Beute-Singularität
de.desc: Wenn das schwarze Loch Gegner verschlingt, verwandelt es sie in Weltraum-Materie. Sobald es genug davon gesammelt hat, verwandelt das schwarze Loch die Materie in Beute! Du erhältst einen Cho'Gath und eine Lissandra. Weltraum-Materie und Beutequalität erhöhen sich jedes Mal. Du erhältst 2/3/4 Weltraum-Materie, abhängig von der Sternenvernichter-Attributsschwelle. Weltraum-Materie: /

en.name: Loot Singularity
en.desc: When the Black Hole consumes enemies, it turns them into space matter. After acquiring enough, the Black Hole turns it into loot! Gain a Cho'gath and a Lissandra. Space matter and loot quality increase each time. Gain 2/3/4 space matter depending on Dark Star breakpoint. Space Matter: /

ko.name: 전리품 특이점
ko.desc: 블랙홀이 적을 집어삼키면 해당 적이 우주 물질로 변합니다. 충분한 양을 모으면 블랙홀이 우주 물질을 전리품으로 바꿉니다! 초가스와 리산드라를 획득합니다.매번 우주 물질 양과 전리품 품질이 증가합니다. 암흑의 별 특성 구간에 따라 우주 물질 2/3/4개를 획득합니다.우주 물질: /

zh.name: 战利品奇点
zh.desc: 当【黑洞】吞噬敌人时，它会将其转变成太空物质。在获取了足够数量之后，该【黑洞】会将它转变为战利品！获得1个【科加斯】和1个【丽桑卓】。太空物质和战利品的品质每次都会提升。获得2/3/4太空物质，基于【暗星】的层级。太空物质： /

es.name: Singularidad de botín
es.desc: Cuando el agujero negro consume a sus enemigos, los convierte en materia espacial. Una vez conseguida la cantidad suficiente, ¡se convierte en botín! Obtienes 1 Cho'Gath y 1 Lissandra. La materia espacial y la calidad del botín aumentan cada vez. Obtienes 2/3/4 de materia espacial en función del umbral de Estrella oscura. Materia espacial: /

fr.name: Butin cosmique
fr.desc: Le Trou noir consume des ennemis et les transforme en matière cosmique. Lorsqu'il a assez de matière, le Trou noir la transforme en butin ! Vous gagnez un Cho'Gath et une Lissandra. La quantité de matière cosmique et la qualité du butin augmentent à chaque fois. Vous gagnez 2/3/4 de matière cosmique selon le palier de Pulsar sombre. Matière cosmique: /

TFT17_Augment_EkkoGodAugment.name: Ekko's Boon
TFT17_Augment_EkkoGodAugment.desc: Gain the Anomaly, an item which grants units a powerful evolution depending on their role. Gain 2 Magnetic Removers.

de.name: Ekkos Segen
de.desc: Du erhältst die Anomalie. Dieser Gegenstand gewährt Einheiten abhängig von ihrer Rolle eine mächtige Entwicklung. Du erhältst 2 magnetische Entferner.

en.name: Ekko's Boon
en.desc: Gain the Anomaly, an item which grants units a powerful evolution depending on their role. Gain 2 Magnetic Removers.

ko.name: 에코의 은총
ko.desc: 이상 현상을 획득합니다. 역할군에 따라 유닛을 강력하게 진화시키는 아이템입니다. 자석 제거기 2개를 획득합니다.

zh.name: 艾克的恩赐
zh.desc: 获得【突变】，一个基于单位的定位为其提供强力进化的装备。获得2个【装备拆卸器】。

es.name: Gracia de Ekko
es.desc: Obtienes una anomalía, un objeto que otorga a las unidades una poderosa evolución según su rol. Obtienes 2 Limpiadores magnéticos.

fr.name: Bénédiction d'Ekko
fr.desc: Obtenez l'Anomalie, un objet qui confère aux unités une évolution puissante selon leur rôle. Vous gagnez 2 Suppresseurs magnétiques.

TFT17_Augment_EvelynnGodAugment.name: Evelynn's Boon
TFT17_Augment_EvelynnGodAugment.desc: Your team gains 10% Durability. Lose an additional 1 Tactician Health when you lose combat.

de.name: Evelynns Segen
de.desc: Dein Team erhält 10 % Durchhaltevermögen. Du verlierst 1 Taktikerleben zusätzlich, wenn du einen Kampf verlierst.

en.name: Evelynn's Boon
en.desc: Your team gains 10% Durability. Lose an additional 1 Tactician Health when you lose combat.

ko.name: 이블린의 은총
ko.desc: 아군이 내구력을 10% 얻습니다. 전투 패배 시 전략가 체력을 1 추가로 잃습니다.

zh.name: 伊芙琳的恩赐
zh.desc: 你的队伍获得10%伤害减免。在你输掉对战回合时，额外失去1小小英雄生命值。

es.name: Gracia de Evelynn
es.desc: Tu equipo obtiene un 10% de durabilidad. Pierdes 1 de vida de estratega adicional al perder un combate.

fr.name: Bénédiction d'Evelynn
fr.desc: Votre équipe gagne 10% de durabilité. Vous perdez 1 PV de Tacticien supplémentaire lorsque vous perdez un combat.

TFT17_Augment_EvelynnGodAugment_BloodPri.name: Blood Price
TFT17_Augment_EvelynnGodAugment_BloodPri.desc: Gain 25 Tactician Health. Your rightmost shop slot costs Tactician Health instead of gold.

de.name: Blutzoll
de.desc: Du erhältst 25 Taktikerleben. Der Händler ganz rechts kostet Taktikerleben statt Gold.

en.name: Blood Price
en.desc: Gain 25 Tactician Health. Your rightmost shop slot costs Tactician Health instead of gold.

ko.name: 피의 대가
ko.desc: 전략가 체력을 25 얻습니다. 상점 가장 오른쪽 슬롯이 골드 대신 전략가 체력을 소모합니다.

zh.name: 猩红报偿
zh.desc: 获得25小小英雄生命值。你商店的最右侧栏位需要花费小小英雄生命值，而非金币。

es.name: Precio sangriento
es.desc: Otorga 25 de vida de estratega. El hueco de más a la derecha de la tienda cuesta vida de estratega en lugar de oro.

fr.name: Sanguinaire
fr.desc: Vous gagnez 25 PV de Tacticien. Votre emplacement de boutique le plus à droite coûte des PV de Tacticien au lieu de PO.

TFT17_Augment_GragasCarry.name: Self Destruct
TFT17_Augment_GragasCarry.desc: Gain a Gragas. Your strongest Gragas becomes a Magic Fighter with a massive explosion, but also damages himself.

de.name: Selbstzerstörung
de.desc: Du erhältst einen Gragas. Dein stärkster Gragas wird zu einem Magiekämpfer mit einer gewaltigen Explosion, die ihm aber auch selbst Schaden zufügt.

en.name: Self Destruct
en.desc: Gain a Gragas. Your strongest Gragas becomes a Magic Fighter with a massive explosion, but also damages himself.

ko.name: 자폭
ko.desc: 그라가스를 획득합니다. 가장 강한 아군 그라가스가 주문력 전사로 변해 거대한 폭발을 일으키지만, 자신도 피해를 입습니다.

zh.name: 自我毁灭
zh.desc: 获得1个【古拉加斯】。你最强大的那个【古拉加斯】成为一名魔法战士，他可以引发巨大爆炸，但也会对其自身造成伤害。

es.name: Autodestrucción
es.desc: Obtienes 1 Gragas. Tu Gragas más fuerte se convierte en un luchador mágico que desata una explosión gigantesca, pero también recibe daño.

fr.name: Autodestruction
fr.desc: Vous gagnez un Gragas. Votre Gragas le plus puissant devient un combattant magique qui provoque des explosions massives qui lui infligent également des dégâts.

TFT17_Augment_InvaderZed.name: Invader Zed
TFT17_Augment_InvaderZed.desc: Gain a Spear of Shojin. On Stage 4-2, gain a Zed. After receiving Zed, he can then appear in your shops. Zed is a 5-cost Attack Fighter that creates clones of himself.

de.name: Eindringling Zed
de.desc: Du bekommst „Speer von Shojin“. Du erhältst einen Zed in Phase 4-2. Nachdem du Zed erhalten hast, kann er beim Händler erscheinen. Zed ist ein 5-Gold-AD-Kämpfer, der Klone von sich selbst erschafft.

en.name: Invader Zed
en.desc: Gain a Spear of Shojin. On Stage 4-2, gain a Zed. After receiving Zed, he can then appear in your shops. Zed is a 5-cost Attack Fighter that creates clones of himself.

ko.name: 침략자 제드
ko.desc: 쇼진의 창을 획득합니다. 스테이지 4-2에 제드를 획득합니다. 제드를 획득한 후 상점에 제드가 등장할 수 있습니다.제드는 5단계 공격력 전사로, 자신의 분신을 생성합니다.

zh.name: 天煞灭影：劫
zh.desc: 获得1个【朔极之矛】。在回合4-2时，获得1个【劫】。在获得【劫】后，他才会在你的商店中出现。【劫】是一名5费物理战士，可以创造出他自己的分身。

es.name: Invasión de Zed
es.desc: Obtienes 1 Lanza de Shojin. En la fase 4-2, obtienes 1 Zed. Tras recibir a Zed, podrá aparecer en la tienda. Zed es un luchador de ataque de coste 5 que crea clones de sí mismo.

fr.name: Zed
fr.desc: Vous gagnez une Lance de Shojin. À la phase 4-2, vous gagnez un Zed. Une fois Zed obtenu, il pourra apparaître dans vos boutiques. Zed est un combattant physique à 5 PO qui crée des clones de lui-même.

TFT17_Augment_IvernMinionCarry.name: The Big Bang
TFT17_Augment_IvernMinionCarry.desc: Gain a Meepsie. Your strongest Meepsie becomes a Magic Fighter that leaps to a nearby hex to deal damage in a large radius.

de.name: Der Urknall
de.desc: Du erhältst einen Meepsie. Dein stärkster Meepsie wird zu einem magischen Kämpfer, der auf ein nahes Feld springt, um in einem großen Umkreis Schaden zu verursachen.

en.name: The Big Bang
en.desc: Gain a Meepsie. Your strongest Meepsie becomes a Magic Fighter that leaps to a nearby hex to deal damage in a large radius.

ko.name: 빅뱅
ko.desc: 꼬마 정령을 획득합니다. 가장 강한 아군 꼬마 정령이 주문력 전사로 변하며 주변 칸으로 도약하여 넓은 반경에 피해를 입힙니다.

zh.name: 宇宙大爆炸
zh.desc: 获得1个【小木灵】。你最强大的那个【小木灵】成为一个魔法战士，可以跳向一个附近的格子以在一个大范围内造成伤害。

es.name: El Big Bang
es.desc: Obtienes 1 Meepsie. Tu Meepsie más fuerte se convierte en un luchador de magia que se abalanza sobre un hexágono cercano para infligir daño en un radio amplio.

fr.name: Big Bang
fr.desc: Vous gagnez une Marguereep. Votre Marguereep la plus puissante devient un combattant magique qui saute sur un hexagone proche pour infliger des dégâts dans un plus grand rayon.

TFT17_Augment_JaxCarry.name: Reach for the Stars
TFT17_Augment_JaxCarry.desc: Gain a Jax. Your strongest Jax becomes a Magic Fighter that deal bonus magic damage on attack and gains stacking Attack Speed on cast.

de.name: Nach dem Himmel greifen
de.desc: Du erhältst einen Jax. Dein stärkster Jax wird zu einem magischen Kämpfer, der bei Angriffen zusätzlichen magischen Schaden verursacht und bei jedem Einsatz seiner Fähigkeit kumulierendes Angriffstempo erhält.

en.name: Reach for the Stars
en.desc: Gain a Jax. Your strongest Jax becomes a Magic Fighter that deal bonus magic damage on attack and gains stacking Attack Speed on cast.

ko.name: 저 별을 향해
ko.desc: 잭스를 획득합니다. 가장 강한 아군 잭스가 주문력 전사로 변하며 기본 공격 시 추가 마법 피해를 입히고 스킬 사용 시 중첩되는 공격 속도를 얻습니다.

zh.name: 摘星之志
zh.desc: 获得1个【贾克斯】。你最强大的那个【【贾克斯】成为一个魔法战士，可以在攻击时造成额外魔法伤害并且在施放技能时获得可叠加的攻击速度。

es.name: Apunta a las estrellas
es.desc: Obtienes 1 Jax. Tu Jax más fuerte se convierte en un luchador de magia que inflige daño mágico adicional con sus ataques y obtiene velocidad de ataque acumulable al lanzar su habilidad.

fr.name: Jaximus
fr.desc: Vous gagnez un Jax. Votre Jax le plus puissant devient un combattant magique qui inflige des dégâts magiques bonus à chaque attaque et gagne de la vitesse d'attaque cumulable à chaque lancement de compétence.

TFT17_Augment_KayleGodAugment.name: Kayle's Boon
TFT17_Augment_KayleGodAugment.desc: For each unique completed item on your team, your team gains 10 Health, 1% Attack Damage, and 1% Ability Power.

de.name: Kayles Segen
de.desc: Für jeden vollständigen einzigartigen Gegenstand erhält dein Team 10 Leben, 1 % Angriffsschaden und 1 % Fähigkeitsstärke.

en.name: Kayle's Boon
en.desc: For each unique completed item on your team, your team gains 10 Health, 1% Attack Damage, and 1% Ability Power.

ko.name: 케일의 은총
ko.desc: 아군이 장착한 서로 다른 완성 아이템 하나당 체력을 10, 공격력을 1%, 주문력을 1% 얻습니다.

zh.name: 凯尔的恩赐
zh.desc: 你的队伍每携带一件不同的成装，就会获得10生命值、1%物理加成和1%法术加成。

es.name: Gracia de Kayle
es.desc: Por cada objeto completo único en tu equipo, este obtiene 10 de vida, un 1% de daño de ataque y un 1% de poder de habilidad.

fr.name: Bénédiction de Kayle
fr.desc: Pour chaque objet complet unique dans votre équipe, votre équipe gagne 10 PV, 1% de dégâts d'attaque et 1% de puissance.

TFT17_Augment_KayleGodAugment_Scrapper.name: Boon of the Scrapper
TFT17_Augment_KayleGodAugment_Scrapper.desc: Combat start: Up to 3 components temporarily turn into completed items. Gain 3 removers and a salvager. Salvagers allow you to break completed items into components

de.name: Gefälligkeit des Schrotthändlers
de.desc: Bei Kampfbeginn verwandeln sich bis zu 3 Gegenstandskomponenten vorübergehend in vollständige Gegenstände. Du erhältst 3 Entferner und eine Schrottpresse. Mit Schrottpressen kannst du vollständige Gegenstände in Komponenten zerlegen

en.name: Boon of the Scrapper
en.desc: Combat start: Up to 3 components temporarily turn into completed items. Gain 3 removers and a salvager. Salvagers allow you to break completed items into components

ko.name: 고철 수집가의 은총
ko.desc: 전투 시작: 최대 3개의 조합 아이템이 일시적으로 완성 아이템으로 변합니다. 자석 제거기 3개 및 재활용 전문가 1개를 획득합니다.재활용 전문가를 이용해 완성 아이템을 조합 아이템으로 분해할 수 있습니다.

zh.name: 斗神的恩赐
zh.desc: 战斗开始时：最多3个基础装备暂时变为成装。获得3个【装备拆卸器】和1个【分解器】。【分解器】允许你将成装拆分成基础装备

es.name: Bendición de la chatarra
es.desc: Comienzo del combate: Hasta 3 componentes se convierten temporalmente en objetos completos. Obtienes 3 Limpiadores y 1 Reforjador. Los Reforjadores permiten dividir los objetos completos en componentes.

fr.name: Bénédiction du Ferrailleur
fr.desc: Début du combat: jusqu'à 3 de vos composants se transforment temporairement en objets complets. Vous gagnez 3 Suppresseurs et un Recycleur. Les Recycleurs vous permettent de désassembler des objets complets en composants.

TFT17_Augment_LeonaCarry.name: Shieldmaiden
TFT17_Augment_LeonaCarry.desc: Gain a Leona. Your strongest Leona becomes an Attack Fighter that dashes through enemies to deal physical damage, stunning the first target hit.

de.name: Schildmaid
de.desc: Du erhältst eine Leona. Deine stärkste Leona wird zu einer Angriffs-Kämpferin, die durch Gegner sprintet, um ihnen normalen Schaden zuzufügen, und das erste getroffene Ziel betäubt.

en.name: Shieldmaiden
en.desc: Gain a Leona. Your strongest Leona becomes an Attack Fighter that dashes through enemies to deal physical damage, stunning the first target hit.

ko.name: 방패 여전사
ko.desc: 레오나를 획득합니다. 가장 강한 아군 레오나가 공격력 전사로 변하고, 적을 가로질러 돌진해 물리 피해를 입히며 처음 적중한 대상을 기절시킵니다.

zh.name: 盾女
zh.desc: 获得1个【蕾欧娜】。你最强大的那个【蕾欧娜】成为一个物理战士，可冲刺穿过敌人们以造成物理伤害并对命中的第一个目标造成晕眩。

es.name: Doncella escudera
es.desc: Obtienes 1 Leona. Tu Leona más fuerte se convierte en una luchadora de ataque que se desliza a través de los enemigos para infligir daño físico y aturdir al primer objetivo golpeado.

fr.name: Guerrière au bouclier
fr.desc: Vous gagnez une Leona. Votre Leona la plus forte devient un combattant physique qui se rue à travers les ennemis pour infliger des dégâts physiques, étourdissant la première cible touchée.

TFT17_Augment_MordekaiserCarry.name: Heat Death
TFT17_Augment_MordekaiserCarry.desc: Gain a Mordekaiser. Your strongest Mordkaiser becomes a Magic Fighter with a slowly growing aura that deals damage over time.

de.name: Hitzetod
de.desc: Du erhältst einen Mordekaiser. Dein stärkster Mordekaiser wird zu einem magischen Kämpfer mit einer sich langsam ausbreitenden Aura, die über Zeit Schaden verursacht.

en.name: Heat Death
en.desc: Gain a Mordekaiser. Your strongest Mordkaiser becomes a Magic Fighter with a slowly growing aura that deals damage over time.

ko.name: 뜨거운 죽음
ko.desc: 모데카이저를 획득합니다. 가장 강한 아군 모데카이저가 주문력 전사로 변하며 서서히 커지는 오라로 지속 피해를 입힙니다.

zh.name: 热寂
zh.desc: 获得1个【莫德凯撒】。你最强大的那个【莫德凯撒】成为一名魔法战士，他现在拥有一个缓慢成长的光环，能够持续造成伤害。

es.name: Muerte acalorada
es.desc: Obtienes 1 Mordekaiser. Tu Mordekaiser más fuerte se convierte en un luchador de magia con un aura que crece lentamente y que inflige daño prolongado.

fr.name: Chaleur mortelle
fr.desc: Vous gagnez un Mordekaiser. Votre Mordekaiser le plus puissant devient un combattant magique doté d'une aura grandissante qui inflige des dégâts sur la durée.

TFT17_Augment_NasusCarry.name: Bonk!
TFT17_Augment_NasusCarry.desc: Gain a Nasus. Your strongest Nasus becomes an Attack Fighter with a single target Ability that gets stronger with each kill.

de.name: Bonk!
de.desc: Du erhältst einen Nasus. Dein stärkster Nasus wird zu einem AD-Kämpfer mit einer Fähigkeit, die auf ein einzelnes Ziel wirkt und mit jedem Kill stärker wird.

en.name: Bonk!
en.desc: Gain a Nasus. Your strongest Nasus becomes an Attack Fighter with a single target Ability that gets stronger with each kill.

ko.name: 꽁!
ko.desc: 나서스를 획득합니다. 가장 강한 아군 나서스가 공격력 전사로 변하며 적을 처치할 때마다 강화되는 단일 대상 스킬을 얻습니다.

zh.name: 邦！
zh.desc: 获得1个【内瑟斯】。你最强大的那个【内瑟斯】成为一名物理战士，他的技能现在是单体目标技能，每完成一次击杀都会变得更强。

es.name: ¡Bonk!
es.desc: Obtienes 1 Nasus. Tu Nasus más fuerte se convierte en un luchador de ataque con una habilidad que afecta a un solo objetivo y se potencia con cada asesinato.

fr.name: Bonk !
fr.desc: Vous gagnez un Nasus. Votre Nasus le plus fort devient un combattant physique doté d'une compétence à cible unique qui gagne en puissance à chaque élimination.

TFT17_Augment_PoppyCarry.name: Termeepnal Velocity
TFT17_Augment_PoppyCarry.desc: Gain a Poppy. Your strongest Poppy becomes a ranged Attack Caster that flings a high-velocity Meep at her target.

de.name: Ter-Meep-nale Geschwindigkeit
de.desc: Du erhältst eine Poppy. Deine stärkste Poppy wird zu einer Fernkampf-AD-Zauberin, die einen superschnellen Meep auf ihr Ziel schleudert.

en.name: Termeepnal Velocity

fr.desc: Les champions sur votre plateau se transforment définitivement en champions aléatoires du palier de coût supérieur (max 5 PO). Vous gagnez 2 Suppresseurs magnétiques et 3 relances.

TFT6_Augment_SalvageBin.name: Salvage Bin
TFT6_Augment_SalvageBin.desc: Gain 1 random completed item now, and 1 component after 8 player combats. Selling champions breaks completed items into components (excluding Tactician's items and Emblems).

de.name: Recyclingtonne
de.desc: Du erhältst 1 zufälligen vollständigen Gegenstand jetzt und 1 Komponente nach je 8 Kämpfen gegen Spieler. Wenn du Champions verkaufst, werden ihre vollständigen Gegenstände in Komponenten aufgeteilt (außer Taktikergegenstände und Embleme).

en.name: Salvage Bin
en.desc: Gain 1 random completed item now, and 1 component after 8 player combats. Selling champions breaks completed items into components (excluding Tactician's items and Emblems).

ko.name: 재활용 쓰레기통
ko.desc: 지금 무작위 완성 아이템 1개를 획득하고 플레이어 대상 전투 8회 후에 조합 아이템 1개를 획득합니다. 챔피언을 판매하면 완성 아이템이 조합 아이템으로 분해됩니다. (전략가의 아이템 및 상징 제외)

zh.name: 打捞桶
zh.desc: 立刻获得1件随机成装，并在8个玩家对战回合之后提供1个基础装备。出售弈子会将其携带的成装拆分成基础装备(冠冕系装备和纹章除外)。

es.name: Contenedor de chatarra
es.desc: Obtienes 1 objeto completo aleatorio ahora y 1 componente tras 8 combates contra jugadores. Al vender a los campeones, los objetos completos se dividen en sus componentes (a excepción de los objetos de estratega y emblemas).

fr.name: Bac de recyclage
fr.desc: Vous gagnez 1 objet complet aléatoire tout de suite, puis 1 composant après 8 combats contre un joueur. Lorsque vous vendez un champion, ses objets complets sont désassemblés (hors objets du Tacticien et emblèmes).

TFT6_Augment_SecondWind1.name: Second Wind
TFT6_Augment_SecondWind1.desc: After 10 seconds of combat, your team heals 40% of their missing Health.

de.name: Aufschwung
de.desc: Nach 10 Sekunden im Kampf heilt sich dein Team um 40 % seines fehlenden Lebens.

en.name: Second Wind
en.desc: After 10 seconds of combat, your team heals 40% of their missing Health.

ko.name: 재생의 바람
ko.desc: 전투 시작 10초 후 아군이 잃은 체력의 40%를 회복합니다.

zh.name: 复苏之风
zh.desc: 在战斗环节开始10秒后，你的弈子们回复其40%已损失生命值。

es.name: Fuerzas renovadas
es.desc: Tras 10 s de combate, tu equipo se cura un 40% de la vida que le falte.

fr.name: Second souffle
fr.desc: Après 10 sec de combat, votre équipe récupère 40% de ses PV manquants.

TFT6_Augment_SecondWind2.name: Second Wind II
TFT6_Augment_SecondWind2.desc: After 10 seconds of combat, your team heals 60% of their missing Health.

de.name: Aufschwung II
de.desc: Nach 10 Sekunden im Kampf heilt sich dein Team um 60 % seines fehlenden Lebens.

en.name: Second Wind II
en.desc: After 10 seconds of combat, your team heals 60% of their missing Health.

ko.name: 재생의 바람 II
ko.desc: 전투 시작 10초 후 아군이 잃은 체력의 60%를 회복합니다.

zh.name: 复苏之风 II
zh.desc: 在战斗环节开始10秒后，你的弈子们回复其60%已损失生命值。

es.name: Fuerzas renovadas II
es.desc: Tras 10 s de combate, tu equipo se cura un 60% de la vida que le falte.

fr.name: Second souffle II
fr.desc: Après 10 sec de combat, votre équipe récupère 60% de ses PV manquants.

TFT6_Augment_SunfireBoard.name: Sunfire Board
TFT6_Augment_SunfireBoard.desc: Combat Start: Burn all enemies for 18% of their max Health over 18 seconds and reduce healing received by 33%.

de.name: Sonnenfeuer-Brett
de.desc: Kampfbeginn: Alle Gegner werden 18 Sekunden lang um 18 % ihres maximalen Lebens verbrannt und die erhaltene Heilung wird um 33 % verringert.

en.name: Sunfire Board
en.desc: Combat Start: Burn all enemies for 18% of their max Health over 18 seconds and reduce healing received by 33%.

ko.name: 태양불꽃판
ko.desc: 전투 시작: 모든 적을 불태워 18초 동안 대상 최대 체력의 18%만큼 피해를 입히고 받는 회복 효과를 33% 감소시킵니다.

zh.name: 日炎棋盘
zh.desc: 战斗开始时：在18秒里持续灼烧所有敌人18%最大生命值并使其受到的治疗效果降低33%。

es.name: Tablero de fuego solar
es.desc: Comienzo del combate: Quema a todos los enemigos un 18% de su vida máxima durante 18 s y reduce la curación recibida un 33%.

fr.name: Plateau solaire
fr.desc: Début du combat: tous les ennemis sont brûlés et perdent 18% de leurs PV max en 18 sec. De plus, les soins qu'ils reçoivent sont réduits de 33%.

TFT6_Augment_TheGoldenEgg.name: The Golden Egg
TFT6_Augment_TheGoldenEgg.desc: Gain a golden egg that hatches in 11 turns for a huge amount of loot. Winning player combat speeds up the hatch timer by an extra turn.

de.name: Das goldene Ei
de.desc: Du erhältst ein goldenes Ei, das in 11 Runden schlüpft und reichlich Beute gewährt. Siegreiche Kämpfe gegen Spieler beschleunigen das Ausschlüpfen um eine zusätzliche Runde.

en.name: The Golden Egg
en.desc: Gain a golden egg that hatches in 11 turns for a huge amount of loot. Winning player combat speeds up the hatch timer by an extra turn.

ko.name: 황금 알
ko.desc: 11턴 후 부화하는 황금 알을 획득합니다. 알이 부화하면 막대한 전리품을 얻습니다. 플레이어 대상 전투에서 승리하면 부화기 타이머를 한 턴만큼 가속합니다.

zh.name: 金蛋
zh.desc: 获得1个大金蛋，需要11个回合来孵化，在孵化时提供大量战利品。赢下玩家对战回合后会使孵化倒计时加快1个额外的回合。

es.name: El huevo dorado
es.desc: Obtienes un huevo dorado que eclosiona en 11 turnos para otorgarte un botín enorme. Al ganar combates contra jugadores, se acelera la eclosión en un turno adicional.

fr.name: Œuf d'or
fr.desc: Vous gagnez un œuf d'or qui éclot dans 11 tours et octroie une énorme quantité de butins. Gagner un combat contre un joueur réduit le délai d'éclosion d'un tour supplémentaire.

TFT6_Augment_ThriftShop.name: Wise Spending
TFT6_Augment_ThriftShop.desc: You can no longer buy XP. Every time you spend gold to reroll your Shop, gain 2 XP. Gain 1 gold now.

de.name: Weise Ausgaben
de.desc: Du kannst keine ERF mehr kaufen. Jedes Mal, wenn du Gold für eine Händleraktualisierung ausgibst, erhältst du 2 ERF. Erhalte jetzt 1 Gold.

en.name: Wise Spending
en.desc: You can no longer buy XP. Every time you spend gold to reroll your Shop, gain 2 XP. Gain 1 gold now.

ko.name: 현명한 소비
ko.desc: 더 이상 경험치를 구매할 수 없습니다. 상점 새로고침으로 골드를 소모할 때마다 경험치를 2 얻습니다. 즉시 1골드를 획득합니다.

zh.name: 明智消费
zh.desc: 你不能再购买经验值。每次花费金币刷新商店时，获得2经验值。立刻获得1金币。

es.name: Gasto con cabeza
es.desc: Ya no puedes comprar EXP. Cada vez que gastes oro para cambiar la tienda, obtienes 2 de EXP. Obtienes 1 de oro ahora.

fr.name: Dépense réfléchie
fr.desc: Vous ne pouvez plus acheter d'XP. Chaque fois que vous dépensez des PO pour relancer votre boutique, vous gagnez 2 XP. Vous gagnez immédiatement 1 PO.

TFT6_Augment_TinyTitans.name: Tiny Titans
TFT6_Augment_TinyTitans.desc: Increase your current and max player health by 20.

de.name: Winzige Titanen
de.desc: Dein aktuelles und dein maximales Leben werden um 20 erhöht.

en.name: Tiny Titans
en.desc: Increase your current and max player health by 20.

ko.name: 꼬마 거인
ko.desc: 현재 및 최대 플레이어 체력이 20 증가합니다.

zh.name: 小巨人
zh.desc: 使你的当前玩家生命值和最大玩家生命值都提升20。

es.name: Minititanes
es.desc: Aumenta la vida actual y máxima del jugador en 20.

fr.name: P'tits titans
fr.desc: Vos PV de Tacticien actuels et max augmentent de 20.

TFT6_Augment_TradeSector.name: Trade Sector
TFT6_Augment_TradeSector.desc: Gain a free Shop reroll every round. Gain 2 gold.

de.name: Handelssektor
de.desc: Du erhältst eine kostenlose Händler-Aktualisierung in jeder Runde. Du erhältst 2 Gold.

en.name: Trade Sector
en.desc: Gain a free Shop reroll every round. Gain 2 gold.

ko.name: 교환의 장
ko.desc: 라운드마다 무료 상점 새로고침을 획득합니다. 2골드를 획득합니다.

zh.name: DD街区
zh.desc: 每回合获得1次免费的商店刷新。获得2金币。

es.name: Sector comercial
es.desc: Obtienes un cambio de tienda gratis en cada ronda. Obtienes 2 de oro.

fr.name: Secteur commercial
fr.desc: À chaque manche, vous gagnez une relance gratuite de la boutique. Vous gagnez 2 PO.

TFT6_Augment_TradeSector2.name: Commerce Core
TFT6_Augment_TradeSector2.desc: Gain 16 free Shop rerolls now and 3 every round for the rest of the game.

de.name: Kommerzkern
de.desc: Du erhältst sofort 16 kostenlose Händleraktualisierungen und für den Rest des Spiels jede Runde 3.

en.name: Commerce Core
en.desc: Gain 16 free Shop rerolls now and 3 every round for the rest of the game.

ko.name: 거래 중심지
ko.desc: 즉시 무료 상점 새로고침 16회를 얻고 게임이 끝날 때까지 라운드마다 3회를 얻습니다.

zh.name: 贸易中心
zh.desc: 立刻获得16次免费商店刷新，并在剩余游戏时间内每回合获得3次免费商店刷新。

es.name: Núcleo comercial
es.desc: Obtienes 16 cambios de tienda gratis ahora y 3 cambios cada ronda durante el resto de la partida.

fr.name: Relances régulières
fr.desc: Vous gagnez 16 relances gratuites immédiatement et 3 à chaque manche pendant le reste de la partie.

TFT7_Augment_AFK.name: AFK
TFT7_Augment_AFK.desc: You cannot perform actions for the next 3 rounds. Afterwards, gain 17 gold.

de.name: Abwesend
de.desc: Du kannst in den nächsten 3 Runden keine Aktionen durchführen. Danach erhältst du 17 Gold.

en.name: AFK
en.desc: You cannot perform actions for the next 3 rounds. Afterwards, gain 17 gold.

ko.name: 자리 비움
ko.desc: 다음 3라운드 동안 아무 행동을 취할 수 없습니다. 이후 17골드를 얻습니다.

zh.name: 开摆
zh.desc: 你在接下来的3回合里无法采取任何行动。在此之后，获得17金币。

es.name: AFK
es.desc: No puedes realizar acciones durante las próximas 3 ronda(s). Después, obtienes 17 de oro.

fr.name: AFK
fr.desc: Vous ne pouvez faire aucune action pendant 3 manches. Ensuite, vous gagnez 17 PO.

de.name: Diebesbande
de.desc: Erhalte 1 Handschuh(e) des Diebs.

en.name: Band of Thieves
en.desc: Gain 1 Thief's Gloves.

ko.name: 도둑 무리
ko.desc: 도적의 장갑 1개를 획득합니다.

zh.name: 窃贼帮派
zh.desc: 提供1个【窃贼手套】。

es.name: Panda de ladrones
es.desc: Obtienes 1 Guantes de ladrón.

fr.name: Bande de voleurs
fr.desc: Vous gagnez 1 Gant(s) de voleur.

TFT7_Augment_BestFriends1.name: Best Friends I
TFT7_Augment_BestFriends1.desc: Allies isolated in pairs gain 10% Attack Speed and 9 Armor and Magic Resist at the start of combat.

de.name: Beste Freunde I
de.desc: Verbündete, die paarweise isoliert sind, erhalten bei Kampfbeginn 10 % Angriffstempo und 9 Rüstung und Magieresistenz.

en.name: Best Friends I
en.desc: Allies isolated in pairs gain 10% Attack Speed and 9 Armor and Magic Resist at the start of combat.

ko.name: 단짝 I
ko.desc: 둘이서 고립된 아군이 전투 시작 시 공격 속도를 10%, 방어력 및 마법 저항력을 9 얻습니다.

zh.name: 最佳好友 I
zh.desc: 在战斗环节开始时，你独立成对的弈子获得10%攻击速度和9护甲与魔抗。

es.name: Mejores amiguis I
es.desc: Los aliados aislados en pareja obtienen un 10% de velocidad de ataque y 9 de armadura y resistencia mágica al comienzo del combate.

fr.name: Meilleurs amis I
fr.desc: Au début du combat, vos alliés adjacents à une seule autre unité gagnent 10% de vitesse d'attaque et 9 armure et résistance magique.

TFT7_Augment_BestFriends2.name: Best Friends II
TFT7_Augment_BestFriends2.desc: Allies isolated in pairs gain 15% Attack Speed and 14 Armor and Magic Resist at the start of combat.

de.name: Beste Freunde II
de.desc: Verbündete, die paarweise isoliert sind, erhalten bei Kampfbeginn 15 % Angriffstempo und 14 Rüstung und Magieresistenz.

en.name: Best Friends II
en.desc: Allies isolated in pairs gain 15% Attack Speed and 14 Armor and Magic Resist at the start of combat.

ko.name: 단짝 II
ko.desc: 둘이서 고립된 아군이 전투 시작 시 공격 속도를 15%, 방어력 및 마법 저항력을 14 얻습니다.

zh.name: 最佳好友 II
zh.desc: 在战斗环节开始时，你独立成对的弈子获得15%攻击速度和14护甲与魔抗。

es.name: Mejores amiguis II
es.desc: Los aliados aislados en pareja obtienen un 15% de velocidad de ataque y 14 de armadura y resistencia mágica al comienzo del combate.

fr.name: Meilleurs amis II
fr.desc: Au début du combat, vos alliés adjacents à une seule autre unité gagnent 15% de vitesse d'attaque et 14 armure et résistance magique.

TFT7_Augment_BirthdayPresents.name: Birthday Present
TFT7_Augment_BirthdayPresents.desc: Gain a 2-star champion and 1 gold every time you level up. The champion's cost tier is your level minus 4 (max: 5-cost).

de.name: Geburtstagsgeschenk
de.desc: Du erhältst bei jedem Stufenaufstieg einen 2-Sterne-Champion und 1 Gold. Der Rang des Champions ist deine Stufe minus 4 (mindestens Rang 5).

en.name: Birthday Present
en.desc: Gain a 2-star champion and 1 gold every time you level up. The champion's cost tier is your level minus 4 (max: 5-cost).

ko.name: 생일 선물
ko.desc: 레벨 업할 때마다 2성 챔피언과 1골드를 획득합니다. 획득하는 챔피언의 단계는 상점 레벨보다 4 낮습니다. (최대 5단계)

zh.name: 生日礼物
zh.desc: 在你每次升级时提供1个2星弈子和1金币。这个弈子的费用位阶是你的等级减4(最大值：5费)。

es.name: Regalo de cumpleaños
es.desc: Obtienes 1 campeón de 2 estrellas y 1 de oro cada vez que subas de nivel. El coste del campeón es equivalente a tu nivel menos cuatro (máximo: coste 5).

fr.name: Cadeau d'anniversaire
fr.desc: Vous gagnez un champion 2 étoiles et 1 PO chaque fois que vous montez de niveau. Le palier du champion correspond à votre niveau moins 4 (palier max: 5 PO).

TFT7_Augment_ClutteredMind.name: Cluttered Mind
TFT7_Augment_ClutteredMind.desc: Gain 4 random 1-cost champions now. If your bench is full at the end of player combat, gain 3 XP.

de.name: Chaotischer Geist
de.desc: Du erhältst jetzt 4 zufällige 1-Gold-Champions. Wenn deine Bank am Ende eines Kampfes gegen Spieler voll ist, erhältst du 3 ERF.

en.name: Cluttered Mind
en.desc: Gain 4 random 1-cost champions now. If your bench is full at the end of player combat, gain 3 XP.

ko.name: 어수선한 마음
ko.desc: 즉시 무작위 1단계 챔피언 4명을 획득합니다. 플레이어 대상 전투 라운드 종료 시 대기석에 챔피언이 가득 찼다면 3의 경험치를 획득합니다.

zh.name: 纷乱头脑
zh.desc: 即刻获得4个随机的1费弈子。如果玩家对战回合结束时你的备战席已满，提供3经验。

es.name: Mente saturada
es.desc: Obtienes 4 campeones aleatorios de coste 1 ahora. Si tienes el banquillo lleno al final de un combate contra un jugador, obtienes 3 de experiencia.

fr.name: Esprit encombré
fr.desc: Vous gagnez immédiatement 4 champions à 1 PO aléatoires. Si votre banc est plein à la fin d'un combat contre un joueur, vous gagnez 3 XP.

TFT7_Augment_CursedCrown.name: Cursed Crown
TFT7_Augment_CursedCrown.desc: Gain +2 max team size and your team gains 4% Durability, but you take double player damage when you lose a player combat.

de.name: Verfluchte Krone
de.desc: Du erhältst +2 max. Teamgröße und dein Team erhält 4 % Durchhaltevermögen, dafür erleidest du den doppelten Schaden, wenn du eine PvP-Runde verlierst.

en.name: Cursed Crown
en.desc: Gain +2 max team size and your team gains 4% Durability, but you take double player damage when you lose a player combat.

ko.name: 저주받은 왕관
ko.desc: 최대 팀 규모가 +2 증가하고 아군이 내구력을 4% 얻지만, 플레이어 대상 전투 패배 시 플레이어가 받는 피해량이 두 배 증가합니다.

zh.name: 诅咒冠冕
zh.desc: 提供+2最大队伍规模，并且你的队伍获得4%伤害减免，但你在输掉一场玩家对战回合后会承受2倍的玩家伤害。

es.name: Corona maldita
es.desc: Obtienes +2 de tamaño máximo del equipo y tu equipo obtiene un 4% de durabilidad. Sin embargo, recibes el doble de daño de jugador al perder un combate.

fr.name: Couronne maudite
fr.desc: La taille max de votre équipe augmente de 2 et votre équipe gagne 4% de durabilité, mais vous perdez le double de PV de Tacticien quand vous perdez un combat contre un joueur.

TFT7_Augment_LategameSpecialist.name: Late Game Specialist
TFT7_Augment_LategameSpecialist.desc: When you reach Level 9, gain 27 gold.

de.name: Endgame-Experte
de.desc: Wenn du Stufe 9 erreichst, erhältst du 27 Gold.

en.name: Late Game Specialist
en.desc: When you reach Level 9, gain 27 gold.

ko.name: 후반 전문가
ko.desc: 9레벨에 도달하면 27골드를 획득합니다.

zh.name: 后期专家
zh.desc: 在你到达9级时，提供27金币。

es.name: Especialista en final de partida
es.desc: Cuando alcanzas el nivel 9, obtienes 27 de oro.

fr.name: Spécialiste des fins de partie
fr.desc: Quand vous atteignez le niveau 9, vous gagnez 27 PO.

TFT7_Augment_LivingForge.name: Living Forge
TFT7_Augment_LivingForge.desc: Gain an Artifact anvil now and after every 9 player combats. Artifacts are more powerful items with a unique effect.

de.name: Lebende Schmiede
de.desc: Du erhältst jetzt und nach 9 Kämpfen gegen Spieler eine Artefaktschmiede. Artefakte sind mächtigere Gegenstände mit einzigartigen Effekten.

en.name: Living Forge
en.desc: Gain an Artifact anvil now and after every 9 player combats. Artifacts are more powerful items with a unique effect.

ko.name: 간이 대장간
ko.desc: 지금 그리고 플레이어 대상 전투 9번마다 유물 모루를 획득합니다.유물은 고유한 효과를 지닌 강력한 아이템입니다.

zh.name: 活体锻炉
zh.desc: 立刻以及之后的每9个玩家对战回合后获得1个【神器锻造器】。神器是可以提供独特效果的强力装备。

es.name: Forja viviente
es.desc: Ahora y tras 9 combates contra jugadores, obtienes un Yunque de artefacto. Los artefactos son poderosos objetos con efectos únicos.

fr.name: Forgeron ambulant
fr.desc: Vous gagnez immédiatement une Enclume à artefacts, puis une autre tous les 9 combats contre un joueur. Les artefacts sont des objets plus puissants dotés d'un effet unique.

TFT7_Augment_LuckyGloves.name: Lucky Gloves
TFT7_Augment_LuckyGloves.desc: Thief's Gloves will always give your champions ideal items. Gain 2 Sparring Gloves and 4 gold.

de.name: Glückshandschuhe
de.desc: „Handschuhe des Diebs“ gewähren deinen Champions stets ideale Gegenstände. Du erhältst 2 „Kampfhandschuhe“ und 4 Gold.

en.name: Lucky Gloves
en.desc: Thief's Gloves will always give your champions ideal items. Gain 2 Sparring Gloves and 4 gold.

ko.name: 행운의 장갑
ko.desc: 도적의 장갑이 항상 챔피언에게 최적의 아이템을 제공합니다. 연습용 장갑 2개와 4골드를 획득합니다.
